news.headline: RTW Investments, Susquehanna, Avoro Capital and EcoR1 disclose new stakes in uniQure in 13G filings
news.summary: A wave of Schedule 13G/13G-A filings made public around August 14 showed RTW Investments (3,941,572 shares, ~5.7%), Susquehanna-affiliated entities (3,339,231 shares, ~4.8%), Avoro Capital Advisors (3,625,000 shares, ~6.6%) and EcoR1 Capital all reporting sizeable positions as of the June 30, 2026 record date. The cluster of filings points to continued institutional accumulation ahead of the September AMT-130 four-year data and the Q3 BLA submission.

news.headline: uniQure says an FDA advisory committee for AMT-130 is likely and welcomes the scrutiny
news.summary: Chief Medical Officer Walid Abi-Saab said the company considers an advisory committee meeting for its Huntington's gene therapy probable and is preparing for one, even though the FDA has not formally requested it. His comments came as regulatory uncertainty over unpredictable FDA advisory practices spread across biopharma.

news.headline: Wells Fargo raises uniQure price target to $75, keeps Overweight
news.summary: Wells Fargo lifted its price target on uniQure from $60 to $75 while maintaining an Overweight rating, citing improved visibility on AMT-130's regulatory path and commercial potential following the FDA's alignment on the accelerated-approval pathway and encouraging early AMT-260 epilepsy data.

news.headline: Wolfe Research upgrades uniQure to Outperform, sees a clear path to approval for AMT-130
news.summary: Wolfe analyst Rudy Li moved to Outperform with a $65 target, arguing the market prices AMT-130 approval odds below 50% while Wolfe models roughly 70%, with peak U.S. sales potential near $2 billion. The upgrade followed the FDA's June agreement to accept three-year data as the primary basis for an accelerated-approval BLA.

news.headline: uniQure reports Q2 2026 results, confirms Q3 BLA timeline and cash runway into 2030
news.summary: Revenue was $5.8M and cash plus investments stood at $810.3M as of June 30 after the $259M June raise, funding operations into 2030, while the net loss widened to $81.1M on commercial-readiness spending. Management said final FDA meeting minutes received in July confirmed the accelerated-approval alignment, kept the AMT-130 BLA and UK MAA on track for Q3 2026 with a priority review request, guided to four-year Phase I/II data in September from a June 30 data cut, and detailed the confirmatory study design (randomized standard-of-care control, Total Functional Capacity at 36 months).

catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 data readout
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to report four-year topline safety and efficacy data on all 24 patients from the first two Phase I/II cohorts (12 high-dose, 12 low-dose), plus three-year follow-up on three additional high-dose patients, from a June 30, 2026 data cut and benchmarked against an updated ~26,000-participant Enroll-HD natural-history cohort. The company has entered a self-imposed quiet period ahead of the release, and Stifel, Wolfe and Wells Fargo all flag this as the key near-term catalyst ahead of the BLA and any advisory committee.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 US BLA submission
catalysts.detail: uniQure remains on track to submit the BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease under the FDA accelerated-approval pathway in Q3 2026 and intends to request priority review on the back of its RMAT and Breakthrough Therapy designations, based on final June/July meeting minutes confirming the three-year analysis can serve as the primary clinical basis.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA marketing authorization application
catalysts.detail: Following a successful MHRA pre-submission meeting, uniQure plans a parallel UK MAA for AMT-130 in Q3 2026 on the same three-year data package, giving a second potential approval route independent of the FDA.

catalysts.label: FDA advisory committee (AdCom) meeting
catalysts.detail: Management believes an advisory committee review is likely for what would be the first gene therapy for Huntington's disease and says it is preparing for one, but the FDA has not confirmed a meeting or a date.

catalysts.label: Confirmatory trial design finalized and initiated
catalysts.detail: The FDA requires a randomized, concurrent standard-of-care-controlled confirmatory study with Total Functional Capacity at 36 months as the primary endpoint; uniQure says it intends to start this global trial as soon as possible after the BLA submission.

catalysts.label: Additional international regulatory pathways
catalysts.detail: uniQure said it is actively pursuing further registration routes for AMT-130 beyond the US and UK and expects to give an update in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 second-cohort epilepsy enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to complete enrollment of the second, higher-dose cohort (3x10^12 gc/mL) in the Phase I/IIa refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy study by Q3 2026, ahead of updated data in H1 2027.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 higher-dose epilepsy data
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to report updated Phase I/IIa data in refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy in H1 2027, including the second, higher-dose cohort. First-cohort data showed 79-100% disabling-seizure reductions in three of six patients and mixed results in the other three.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA accelerated approval decision for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: If the BLA is accepted with priority review, an FDA decision on what would be the first gene therapy for Huntington's disease could land around mid-2027, contingent on the September data readout and any advisory committee outcome.

pulse: QURE remains a catalyst-driven, largely binary story heading into its most important month yet: the company has entered a self-imposed quiet period ahead of the September four-year AMT-130 data readout, the last major checkpoint before the Q3 US BLA and UK MAA filings. Sentiment has stayed constructive through late July and August, with Wells Fargo ($75), Stifel and Wolfe ($65, ~70% modeled approval odds) all reiterating bullish calls after Q2 results confirmed $810M of cash and runway into 2030, while RTW Investments, Susquehanna, Avoro Capital and EcoR1 disclosed sizeable mid-August stakes; the stock trades roughly in the mid-$40s and now moves mainly on positioning ahead of the data rather than fresh newsflow. A likely-but-still-unconfirmed FDA advisory committee remains the main open regulatory question heading into the readout and subsequent BLA review.
